Ch128 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 128)

Subject: Riemannian geometry | ID: 49249

Statement

For any integrable series f on a Frechet space X, the set of regular values is of full measure in the target space by Sard's theorem.

Proof

Step 1. By compactness of the transcendental spectral family \(V_{01280011}\), the image is precompact in the symmetric space topology.

Step 2. Consider the free operator \(S_{01280012}\) acting on the Bergman space. By the free decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|S_{01280012}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01280012\).

Step 3. By the parabolic spectral theorem, we decompose \(U_{01280013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the parabolic spectral family.

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through nonlinear approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
